title: TagDuel final-seat Accept versus host cancellation race
priority: P1 — the fourth physical-seat Accept and host cancellation at the same lobby revision must produce exactly one outcome: a fully accepted four-seat duel or a cancelled lobby with every lock released.

design.isolation: Temporary SQLite database; independent Node workers each open their own better-sqlite3 connection; parent connection closes before races.
design.concurrency: Three synchronized cross-process races between tagStore.acceptTag for the final seat and tagStore.quitTag for the host.
design.clock: Both workers use a deterministic timestamp one second after lobby creation and before the five-minute expiry deadline; both use the same expected revision.

assertions: exactly one operation commits; the competing stale revision or SQLite lock conflict fails closed
the terminal revision advances exactly once
Accept winner produces status playing, four accepted physical seats, four tag_members locks and a valid TagDuel state
host-cancel winner produces status cancelled, preserves the three prior acceptances, and releases all four tag_members locks
all physical card UIDs remain unique in a started duel
players, player_cards, starter_grants, decks and deck_cards remain byte-equivalent
limitations: SQLite temporário e processos Node independentes; sem banco persistente.
Valida stores/transações reais, não gateway/guild Discord real.
Relógio determinístico elimina espera de cinco minutos; não mede latência de produção.
Não integra nem certifica cartas; não altera comandos ou runtime.
